producer_report.summary: Added docs/spec.toml (Olympus sections 1-6 requirements with verbatim quotes and headings) and xtask/tests/spec.rs (checker plus 12 tests: real spec passes, four negative cases, heading coverage for R1-R8 and sections 1-5, open-question handling). Recorded D111 in docs/decisions.md, a CHANGELOG entry, enforcement row M33, and a `spec` ontology term. This round I re-ran all checks. fmt and clippy are clean. A grep of the touched files for the policy scanner's banned words and fragments found nothing. All 12 spec tests pass. In the full `cargo test --locked`, the only failure I found is policy's `every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists`. It collects test names from `git ls-files`, which doesn't list the untracked new `xtask/tests/spec.rs`, so the M33 names look undefined. I am not allowed to stage files. It should pass once Athena commits the files. The same applies to the boundary scan, which also reads tracked files only. I scanned the new files by grep instead.

checks_run.note: Everything I could see passes except policy::every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists (8 of 9 policy tests pass). The output was truncated, so I ran `-p xtask` separately to find that failure; other crates' suites beyond the truncated part were not individually inspected. The failure is an artifact of xtask/tests/spec.rs being untracked: the policy test lists files with git ls-files, and I cannot stage. The names it reports missing are exactly the tests defined in spec.rs.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test parses docs/spec.toml and passes, meaning every source quote is a verbatim substring of BRIEF.md after collapsing whitespace, ids are unique, supersedes targets exist, and every requirement has at least one source.

Run `cargo test -p xtask`: in-memory negative cases each make the checker fail for (a) a quote not in BRIEF.md, (b) a duplicate id, (c) a supersedes target that does not exist, (d) a requirement with no source.
criteria_check.evidence: a_quote_not_in_the_brief_is_flagged, a_duplicate_id_is_flagged, a_missing_supersedes_target_is_flagged and a_requirement_without_a_source_is_flagged all pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test counts requirements by their sources' headings and finds at least one each for R1 to R8 and for Olympus sections 1 to 5 (Vision, Pantheon, Feedback, Example, lifecycle with the two loops).

Each requirement in docs/spec.toml has an id, a plain cohesive statement, a kind (goal, requirement, constraint, acceptance), a status (active or superseded), and one or more sources (verbatim quote plus heading); duplicates are merged into one requirement with several sources.
criteria_check.evidence: Typed deserialization with deny_unknown_fields plus kind/status enum checks inside the passing the_spec_matches_the_brief; an_unknown_kind_or_status_is_flagged passes.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml records at least one open question with both verbatim quotes where Sri's words conflict or leave a choice open, unresolved; if sections 1 to 6 contain none, the spec says so and the format and test still support the field.
criteria_check.evidence: The checker verifies open_question quotes and requires either an open question or a stated reason (a_spec_with_neither_open_question_nor_reason_is_flagged, an_open_question_quote_not_in_the_brief_is_flagged, an_open_question_with_verbatim_quotes_is_accepted all pass); the spec file carries the corresponding entry or reason.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml has no statement about who runs Athena or where; xtask/tests/policy.rs still passes.
criteria_check.evidence: Case-insensitive grep of docs/spec.toml, xtask/tests/spec.rs, CHANGELOG.md, docs/decisions.md, docs/enforcement.md and docs/ontology.toml for every banned word and fragment found nothing. In policy.rs, athena_refers_to_no_one_who_runs_it_or_where and the other 7 tests pass. The one exception, every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists, fails only because spec.rs is untracked (git ls-files cannot see it, and I cannot stage); it should pass once the files are committed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo test`: all clean and passing.
criteria_check.evidence: fmt and clippy are clean. cargo test passes except policy::every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists, which fails only because the untracked spec.rs is invisible to git ls-files; the M33 names it reports missing are exactly spec.rs's tests. I cannot stage, so I cannot clear it from here.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the spec; docs/decisions.md records the spec format and the choice of TOML with alternatives (Markdown with ids, JSON, YAML), and notes that sections 7 to 10, the governing philosophy and the 2026-10-17 addenda follow in a second job.
criteria_check.evidence: The entries were written in the earlier round; the policy decision-link tests pass, and grep shows no banned words in these files.

open_issues: policy::every_test_named_in_the_enforcement_map_exists fails in this working directory only because xtask/tests/spec.rs is untracked; it should pass after Athena commits the files.
xtask/Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock needed no change (toml and serde were already dev-dependencies).
mistakes: I did not re-read the CHANGELOG and decisions entries in this round; I rely on the earlier round and on the passing decision-link tests.
learnings: xtask/tests/policy.rs builds its file list from `git ls-files`, so new untracked files are invisible to the M24 test-name check and the boundary scan until committed.
desires: Permission to run `git add -N` (intent-to-add) so policy tests that read git ls-files can see new files.
